responsibility: Manages user registration, login/logout, session identity, role distinction (regular user vs administrator), and duplicate-username prevention. Issues/validates the identity and role context (via aspect-based enforcement) consumed at each service boundary. Backed by UserController and the user domain/repository.

Owns the Movie entity and all its invariants and write operations. Manages catalog reads (paginated home listing with title, poster, rating; movie details lookup with full metadata and cast; category-based discovery including multi-category movies) and administrator-driven catalog writes (movie registration/update/deletion, batch deletion with confirmation, duplicate movie-title enforcement per RF-28/RF-35, error handling for nonexistent movies). Orchestrates video file upload with the Media Delivery Service as a related-but-independent step (RNF-57). Enforces administrator-only access at the write boundary (RF-06, RNF-46, addressing the RNF-60 backend gap). Backed by MovieController, TypeController, and MovieUploadController over the shared Movie domain/repository.

Handles large MP4 video upload (up to 2 GB), storage in the temporary delivery area, on-demand loading from the configured local repository, playback initiation, download link provision, and file-availability checks tied to registered titles. Backed by upload/utility/properties handling.
